title: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
abstract: arXiv:2611.17598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon navigation from indoors to outdoors remains an open problem for humanoid robots: one instruction covers rooms, doors and roads, and the camera moves with the gait. Worken, AGIBOT's measure of productive robot work, depends on robots that reach their workplaces autonomously. We present X-Nav, to our knowledge the first system to take a bipedal humanoid through a language-instructed long-horizon mission from indoors to outdoors. X-Nav covers a pipeline from data to deployment. Its data engine collects navigation data in open-source scenes, in digital twins of deployment sites and on real robots. Its navigation model, MELIOR, takes only RGB images from the robot's built-in camera and comes in two versions: MELIOR-A predicts actions, and MELIOR-N predicts a navigation goal. translated_title: X-Nav技术报告：人形机器人在真实世界中的长时程室内到室外导航
translated_abstract: 从室内到室外长时程导航对人形机器人而言仍然是一个开放性问题：一条指令涵盖房间、门和道路，而相机还随步态移动。Worken是AGIBOT衡量机器人生产力工作的指标，它依赖于机器人能够自主到达工作地点。我们提出X-Nav，据我们所知，这是首个让双足人形机器人根据语言指令完成从室内到室外长时程任务的系统。X-Nav涵盖了从数据到部署的完整流程。其数据引擎在开源场景、部署场地的数字孪生体以及真实机器人上收集导航数据。其导航模型MELIOR仅使用机器人内置摄像头的RGB图像，并有两个版本：MELIOR-A预测动作，MELIOR-N预测导航目标。其智能体工作流X-Navarch将简短的人类指令转化为子任务，并在机器人上部署MELIOR，实现明确的目标导航和障碍物避让。
tldr: X-Nav是首个让双足人形机器人根据语言指令在真实世界中完成从室内到室外长时程导航任务的系统，通过数据引擎、仅依赖RGB图像的MELIOR导航模型以及X-Navarch智能体工作流，实现了从数据到部署的完整流程。
en_tdlr: X-Nav is the first system to enable a bipedal humanoid robot to complete a language-instructed long-horizon navigation mission from indoors to outdoors in the real world, providing a full pipeline from data collection to deployment through its data engine, the RGB-only MELIOR navigation model, and the X-Navarch agentic workflow.
